scope: Actual hard Gaussian threshold derivative, genuine Gaussian section/tube geometry and singular-base averaging
status_policy: Supporting passage inference and statement acceptance are separate. Exact kernel types and routes are fresh hashed working-checkout exports, not a clean whole-paper replay. Lower author-owned source rows await separate independent review. Historical ledgers are preserved.

passages.title: Intrinsic common-threshold derivative
passages.claim: The actual absolute common-threshold derivative averaged against any singular concentrated base is bounded by C*C0*kappa*(sigma L+delta L sqrtL).

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.lemma_B5_intrinsic_threshold
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (RectangleCLT.Vector r)) [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
      (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (a : RectangleCLT.Vector m),
      (∀ (j : Fin m), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1) →
        LinearIndependent ℝ u →
          ∀ {C₀ δ κ L σ : ℝ},
            0 ≤ C₀ →
              0 ≤ κ →
                0 ≤ δ →
                  0 < σ →
                    RectangleCLT.dimensionLog m ≤ 2 * L →
                      RectangleCLTArxivV1.IntrinsicPolyhedralConcentration μ u C₀ δ κ →
                        ∫ (v : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                            |RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdDerivative u
                                (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdsFromBase u a σ v)| ∂μ ≤
                          RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.averagedThresholdPaperConstant * C₀ * κ * (σ * L + δ * L * √L)

passages.title: Actual Gaussian radial differentiation
passages.claim: Differentiating the actual Gaussian density under its polynomial majorant gives the true signed radial threshold trace.

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.hasDerivAt_gaussianLogScaleIntegral
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {r : ℕ} (f : RectangleCLT.Vector r → ℝ),
  Measurable f →
    ∀ (M : ℝ),
      (∀ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r), |f g| ≤ M) →
        HasDerivAt
          (fun t => ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r), RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianLogScaleDensity r t g * f g)
          (∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r), (RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq g - ↑r) * f g ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) 0

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.hasDerivAt_standardGaussian_logScale
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {r : ℕ} (f : RectangleCLT.Vector r → ℝ),
  Measurable f →
    ∀ (M : ℝ),
      (∀ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r), |f g| ≤ M) →
        HasDerivAt (fun t => ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r), f (Real.exp t • g) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r)
          (∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r), (RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq g - ↑r) * f g ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) 0

passages.route_variation: The proof parametrizes variance by an exponential log-scale; this is the same radial derivative after the chain rule.

passages.title: Radial trace equals first derivatives
passages.claim: Actual hard-CDF differentiability and the variance scaling identity give J(b)=-sum b_j C_j(b).

full_type_evidence.expanded_type:

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdTrace_eq_radial_first
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:

passages.title: Conditional and diagonal derivatives
passages.claim: Actual one-normal residual Gaussian conditioning gives the first derivative; differentiating the residual CDF gives the diagonal identity and mixed symmetry.

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdMixed_eq_residualFirst
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (j l : Fin m),
  j ≠ l →
    RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1 →
      LinearIndependent ℝ u →
        RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdMixed u b j l =
          ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (b j) *
            RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianFiniteThresholdFirst (Finset.univ.erase j)
              (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdResidualNormals u j)
              (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdResidualLevels u b j) l

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThreshold_diagonal_identity
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (j : Fin m),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1 →
    LinearIndependent ℝ u →
      RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdMixed u b j j =
        -b j * RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdFirst u b j -
          ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j,
            RectangleCLT.faceDot (u j) (u l) * RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdMixed u b j l

passages.title: Symmetric common-threshold identity
passages.claim: The actual common derivative equals the facet sum minus half the ordered mixed-pair sum, equivalently the printed unordered j<l sum.

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdDerivative_eq_raw
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m),
  (∀ (j : Fin m), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1) →
    LinearIndependent ℝ u →
      RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdDerivative u b =
        ∑ j,
          (-RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdFirst u b j -
            b j * ∑ l, RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdMixed u b j l)

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdDerivative_identity
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m),
  (∀ (j : Fin m), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1) →
    LinearIndependent ℝ u →
      RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdDerivative u b =
        ∑ j, (b j ^ 2 - 1) * RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdFirst u b j -
          1 / 2 *
            ∑ j,
              ∑ l,
                (1 - RectangleCLT.faceDot (u j) (u l)) * (b j + b l) *
                  RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdMixed u b j l

passages.claim: The threshold-independent radius is one plus the maximum of genuine two-normal orthogonal projections; diagonal pairs supply the single normals, including m=1.

passages.title: Dimension-free projection moments
passages.claim: The actual radius has Gaussian second and third moments O(L) and O(L sqrtL), with no correlation-gap or ambient-rank factor.

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdProjectionRadius_moment
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    ∀ (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (k : ℕ),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun g => RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdProjectionRadius u g ^ k)
          (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) ∧
        ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
            RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdProjectionRadius u g ^ k ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r ≤
          √(RectangleCLT.dimensionLog m) ^ k * Real.exp (4 + (2 * (↑k + 1)) ^ 2 / 2)

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdProjectionRadius_second_third_moments
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    ∀ (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun g => RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdProjectionRadius u g ^ 2)
          (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) ∧
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun g => RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdProjectionRadius u g ^ 3)
            (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) ∧
          ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdProjectionRadius u g ^ 2 ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r ≤
              Real.exp 36 * RectangleCLT.dimensionLog m ∧
            ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdProjectionRadius u g ^ 3 ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r ≤
              Real.exp 36 * RectangleCLT.dimensionLog m * √(RectangleCLT.dimensionLog m)

passages.route_variation: The proof uses finite orthonormal projection bases and an exponential moment maximum bound rather than a literal chi-square union-tail calculation; the two stated moment powers are unchanged.

passages.title: Actual strict one-normal section
passages.claim: The actual Gaussian normal replacement map and residual nondegeneracy identify the one-face derivative with the actual strict section probability.

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianNormalSectionMap_measurePreserving
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (u : RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq u = 1 →
    MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianNormalSectionMap u)
      ((ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1).prod (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian (n + 1)))
      (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian (n + 1))

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdSectionProbability_eq_strict
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (j : Fin m),
  LinearIndependent ℝ u →
    ∀ (t : ℝ),
      RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdSectionProbability (Finset.univ.erase j) u b (u j) t =
        (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r).real
          {z |
            ∀ (l : Fin m),
              l ≠ j →
                RectangleCLT.faceDot (u l) (RectangleCLT.Companion.SignedSurface.gaussianSectionPoint (u j) t z) < b l}

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianFacetEvent_section
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (j : Fin m),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1 →
    ∀ (z : RectangleCLT.Vector r) (t : ℝ),
      RectangleCLT.Companion.SignedSurface.gaussianSectionPoint (u j) t z ∈
          RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianFacetEvent u b j ↔
        (∀ (l : Fin m),
            l ≠ j → RectangleCLT.faceDot (u l) (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianFacetBase u b j z) < b l) ∧
          0 < t - b j ∧
            t - b j ≤
              1 /
                (4 *
                  RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdProjectionRadius u
                    (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianFacetBase u b j z))

passages.title: Actual short outward facet mass
passages.claim: The actual truncated normal fiber pays the facet coefficient through genuine Gaussian Fubini and radius comparability.

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdFacet_fiber_lower
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (j : Fin m),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1 →
    ∀ (b : ℝ) (x : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
      RectangleCLT.faceDot (u j) x = b →
        Real.exp (-3 / 2) * (1 + b ^ 2) * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 b / 32 ≤
          ∫ (t : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 (1 / (4 * RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdProjectionRadius u x)),
            RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdProjectionRadius u (x + t • u j) ^ 3 *
              ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (b + t)

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.normal_integral_dominates_translated_fiber
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ (F W : ℝ → ℝ),

    (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ F t) →
      ∀ (b ε : ℝ),
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc 0 ε, F (b + t) = W t) →
          ∫ (t : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 ε, W t * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (b + t) ≤
            ∫ (t : ℝ), F t ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1

passages.title: Actual two-normal density and section
passages.claim: The real rotated Gaussian section has the true determinant/sine normalizer and the actual mixed derivative equals its strict retained-section probability.

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianPair_conditional_density_eq
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (j l : Fin m),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1 →
    RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u l) = 1 →
      RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u j) + RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u l) ≠ 0 →
        RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u j) - RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u l) ≠ 0 →
          ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (b j) *
              ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1
                (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianPairConditionalLevel u b j l) =
            ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdPairFirstLevel u b j l) *
              ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdPairSecondLevel u b j l)

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdMixed_eq_pairBase
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (j l : Fin m),
  j ≠ l →
    RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1 →
      RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u l) = 1 →
        LinearIndependent ℝ u →
          RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianThresholdMixed u b j l =

                    (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdPairSecondLevel u b j l) /

passages.title: Actual outward pair mass
passages.claim: A measurable bisector rectangle inside the genuine positive normal sector pays the actual weighted pair coefficient; the true coordinate Gaussian law justifies Fubini.

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdRidge_fiber_lower
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (j l : Fin m),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1 →
    RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u l) = 1 →
      RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u j) + RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u l) ≠ 0 →
        RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u j) - RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u l) ≠ 0 →
          ∀ (a c : ℝ) (x : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
            RectangleCLT.faceDot (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdPairBisector u j l) x = a →
              RectangleCLT.faceDot (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdPairDifference u j l) x = c →
                Real.exp (-3 / 2) * RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdProjectionRadius u x *
                          ‖RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u j) -
                              RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u l)‖ *
                        ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 a *
                      ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 c /
                    2048 ≤
                  ∫ (st : ℝ × ℝ) in
                    RectangleCLT.Companion.SignedSurface.ridgeRectangle (RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u j))
                      (RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u l))
                      (1 / (4 * RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdProjectionRadius u x)),
                    RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdProjectionRadius u
                            (x + st.1 • RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdPairBisector u j l +
                              st.2 • RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.thresholdPairDifference u j l) ^
                          3 *
                        ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a + st.1) *
                      ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (c + st.2) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.prod MeasureTheory.volume
